question: Should maintainers refresh this PR as the canonical no-dispatch fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92535, or replace it with another structured fix path?
rationale: The patch is in the right owner boundary, but it is maintainer-labeled, currently conflicting with main, and deliberately changes message-delivery/session-cleanup behavior that automation should not merge without maintainer intent.

options.title: Refresh and review this PR
options.body: Rebase or replay the structured bypassCronDelivery approach onto current main, rerun the focused tests, and capture Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow maintainer branch
options.body: If resolving the conflicts is noisier than the useful diff, rebuild the same runner-signal and cron-bypass behavior in a fresh branch while keeping this PR as source context.

options.title: Defer behind broader tool-surface work
options.body: Keep the issue open and coordinate with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84709 only if maintainers want required-tool availability to land before the delivery-boundary fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review this PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or replay the structured bypassCronDelivery approach onto current main, rerun the focused tests, and capture Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current maintainer branch and are assigned to the PR that carries the active implementation.
